_comment: JSON form of the playbook's bands.yaml (original kept in .sdlc/examples/bands.yaml). Detection is deterministic (mean/stddev over a rolling window + Western Electric rules). Claude is invoked only when a band is breached and the tier sets what it may do: 1sigma log, 2sigma diagnose (read-only), 3sigma propose via routes pull_request | runbook:<name> (pre-approved) | report (writes .sdlc/reports/<ts>-<metric>.md for leadership). Metrics with "enabled": false are examples — set the command and flip to true. "_tuning" collects dismissal notes from /sdlc:triage.

metrics.name: ci_test_failure_rate
metrics.description: Share of CI runs that failed in the last 24h (0..1)
metrics.command: gh run list --limit 50 --json conclusion --jq '[.[] | select(.conclusion=="failure")] | length / 50'

2sigma.tools: Read,Grep,Glob,Bash(gh run view *),Bash(gh run list *),Bash(git log *)

metrics.name: eval_pass_rate
metrics.description: Pass rate of the configuration eval suite (appended by run-evals.sh)

metrics.name: post_deploy_5xx_rate
metrics.description: Share of 5xx responses in the 15 minutes after the latest deploy (0..1). Example command: Prometheus HTTP API via curl + jq

metrics.name: pr_cycle_time_hours
metrics.description: Median hours from PR open to merge over the last 20 merged PRs (process metric — a drift rule writes a report for engineering leadership)
metrics.command: gh pr list --state merged --limit 20 --json createdAt,mergedAt --jq '[.[] | ((.mergedAt|fromdate) - (.createdAt|fromdate))/3600] | sort | .[length/2|floor]'
